emi.atouchofdarkness.info.fuel: Any furnace fuel but a tool, used on a placed Lamp or Campfire, or clicked onto a Lamp in an inventory, adds %s times its furnace burn time to its fuel, up to its cap; the rest is lost. Caps: Campfire %s, Soul Campfire %s, Lamp %s, Soul Lamp %s.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.relight: A Spent Torch relights into a Torch that burns a quarter as long as a fresh one: use it with flint and steel, a fire charge, a burning Torch or a Lamp that is on in the other hand, or while looking at fire, lava or a lit campfire.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.vanilla_lights: Vanilla's torches, lanterns and campfires become the Pillar's own in a player's inventory, soul to soul: a torch a Torch, a lantern a full Lamp that is on, a campfire a Campfire.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.no_recipe: Vanilla's cheap light has no recipe here: its torches, lanterns, candles, campfires and the rest. The light config's vanillaLight switch brings the recipes back.
